statement: Samsung expects AI and high-performance-computing applications to make up more than 30% of foundry revenue this year, up from 15% to 20% in late 2025, with advanced processes exceeding half of foundry revenue.
why: A foundry's revenue mix shifting sharply toward AI and HPC is a clean read on where order volume is actually going.

impact.mechanism: A rising AI and HPC share of foundry revenue reflects growing customer orders for AI silicon, confirming accelerator demand is pulling through the manufacturing chain.

evidence.excerpt: Samsung expects advanced processes to account for more than half of foundry revenue this year, while AI and high-performance-computing applications would make up more than 30%, up from 15% to 20% in late 2025.

confidence.basis: Company expectation relayed through a single wire story; secondary-only evidence.
